note: Remaining border/outline declarations painting an edge from an intent BASE rather than from its -border role. Written by hand, read by check:intent-roles. A count may only fall, and a count that has fallen must be lowered here in the same commit — a baseline that no longer describes the code is a baseline nobody can read.
